title: Render svg preview images in File Explorer is too slow

status.label: Needs a representative SVG workload
status.detail: The report gives a directory count and observed delay but no sample SVGs or comparison needed to characterize the performance problem.

next_action.label: Request sample files and timing
next_action.reason: SVG complexity, file size, cache state, and built-in thumbnail behavior can materially change the measured workload.

actions.label: Ask for SVG samples and measurements

comment.body: Could you attach two or three representative SVG files from the slow folder (or reduced samples that reproduce it), and provide one timed comparison after clearing/rebuilding thumbnails with PowerToys SVG thumbnails enabled versus disabled? Please include approximate file sizes, whether the SVGs reference external images/fonts, and confirm whether 4–5 seconds is per thumbnail or for the full folder.

judgment.rationale: The current description establishes slowness but does not provide a reproducible SVG workload or a baseline separating PowerToys from Explorer thumbnail generation.
evidence: The reporter observes at least 50 SVG thumbnails rendering one by one.
The stated delay is 4–5 seconds, but it is ambiguous whether that is per image or total.
The attachment is a screenshot rather than a representative SVG file or comparative timing.
judgment.recommended_action: Request public sample SVGs and a controlled enabled/disabled timing comparison.
